mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the potatoes and turning them into stew made the earlier planting and storm survival feel consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: Shelling and soaking the beans were sensible but predictable preparation steps, with little decision-making.

surprise.text: The potato harvest arrived already washed and cut, combining several preparation actions into one result.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though using a cloth to shell the pods was not entirely clear until the result explained it.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the specimen return unfolds; this meal was a satisfying pause, although the largely predetermined sequence offered few meaningful choices.
